items.title: Ruth Lion interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: I just loved that “Am I Blue.” ... Have you heard — you know Grant Green?

ctx.x: Yeah, wow, that’s interesting. There you are playing his records, and there he is. Great.

Yes. I feel that way. In fact, there was one Grant Green — and I just loved that “Am I Blue.” And I said, “Alfred, I have to play this and play it and play it and play it because if you leave me, and I listen to that, and I haven’t heard it, I wouldn’t be able to handle it, so I listened and listened and listened. And after he’s gone, I can’t listen to “Am I Blue.” It was gorgeous. Have you heard — you know Grant Green? © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-

Yeah. Well I’d like to talk for a moment about Alfred, coming from Germany, in the ‘30s, and whether or not the atmosphere, the social atmosphere that he lived in, do you think it had an effect on him looking for something else, and finding it in American jazz.
